semantics.function: Both outputs choose b when sel_b1 and sel_b2 are both 1; otherwise choose a.
semantics.timing: Combinational, no clock, extra latency, or retained state. Original specifies only a mux and lists no clock.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior in original.
semantics.initialization: No initial values specified; outputs follow combinational inputs once evaluated.

numeric.widths: Every port is one bit, as explicitly stated.
numeric.domain: Exhaustive binary input combinations define required truth table; no arithmetic or signedness.

verification.oracle: Independent explicit selector truth table based on original choose-b-if-both-true rule.
verification.cases: All 16 binary combinations in ascending and descending order, exercising changes to data and selection.
verification.sampling: Apply inputs then wait 1 ns for combinational settling before checking both outputs.
verification.failure: Case-inequality comparison, fatal on mismatch, 100 ns timeout; PASS only after all checks.

specification_ambiguities: Behavior for X/Z selectors is unspecified; development truth-table checks use binary inputs. Standard Verilog conditional and procedural-if semantics apply for unspecified four-state inputs.
